title: Lewis and Short Latin-English Dictionary in LiLa

description.en: A Latin Dictionary by Charlton T. Lewis and Charles Short is a popular English-language lexicographical work of the Latin language, published by Harper and Brothers of New York in 1879 and printed simultaneously in the United Kingdom by Oxford University Press. The version published in LiLa is derived from the digital one provided by the Perseus Digital Library (in XML format).
